run_gen_character_spec: run gen_character_spec with num_api_spec_tokens=64 to generate a character using speculative decoding
run_gen_character_no_spec: run gen_character_no_spec without speculative tokens to generate a character for comparison
run_gen_character_spec_no_few_shot: run gen_character_spec_no_few_shot with speculative decoding and no few-shot examples

test_token_usage: test backend token usage tracking by resetting and printing token counts after each function run
